rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Hive Compute Grid is a cross-pool compute auction marketplace routing workloads across io.net, Akash, and Render. Eleven tools cover capacity querying, quote gathering, auction execution, compute booking, and transaction auditing. Manages a 15-agent fleet across 6 driver types with Groth16-style cryptographic selection proofs and real USDC/USDT settlement on Base, Ethereum, and Solana.
